reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "The deprecated Helm option `remoteNodeIdentity` has been removed", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: setting-ignored

consequence.statement: The remoteNodeIdentity Helm value is no longer honoured; remote nodes will always use remote-node identity. Network policies based on enable-remote-node-identity=false must be updated.
consequence.remediation: Remove remoteNodeIdentity from Helm values. Review and update any network policies that were based on enable-remote-node-identity=false to align with the new always-enabled remote-node identity behavior.

proposed.statement: The deprecated Helm value remoteNodeIdentity has been removed in Cilium 1.16.0; environments with this value explicitly set must update their configuration and any related network policies.
